en-US.longDescription: Boom is a Chinese video conferencing software based on 20 years of experience in audio and video research and development. With refreshing interface, simple operation, stability and reliability, Boom supports multi-user audio and video conferencing, screen sharing, meeting recording, drawing and other functions, allowing you to meet anytime, anywhere, no matter in the office, workplace, home or business trips, and improve work efficiency.
en-US.name: Boom
en-US.publisher: 济南中视慧云科技有限公司
